% Converted, ltx-talk. C-FRAMESTAR-TAG workaround: frame* for the verbatim, PLUS
% order-independent hooks suspending tagging around the WHOLE frame*. Without the
% hooks this errors ("there is no open structure on the stack" at \end{frame*},
% mismatched begin/end counts, poppler "Mismatched EMC operator").
%
% Things that do NOT work, all tried: suspending only the lstlisting; using
% \SuspendTagging/\ResumeTagging instead of \tag_stop:/\tag_start:; adding tagging
% phases; \lstinputlisting from an external file in a normal frame.
%
% TRADE-OFF, larger than it looks: the hooks suspend tagging for the entire
% environment, so EVERYTHING on this slide becomes an artifact -- prose, itemize,
% tabular, figures -- none of it in the screen-reader reading order, and any
% \tagpdfsetup written inside the frame is inert. Keep a frame* down to the
% listing plus the minimum around it, and put anything that matters
% pedagogically outside the frame as tagged content.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard=a-4, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}
\usepackage{listings}

\ExplSyntaxOn
\AddToHook{env/frame*/before}{\tag_stop:}
\AddToHook{env/frame*/after}{\tag_start:}
\ExplSyntaxOff

\begin{document}
\begin{frame*}
\frametitle{Gripper domain}
\begin{lstlisting}
(define (domain gripper)
  (:requirements :strips))
\end{lstlisting}
\end{frame*}
\end{document}
